description: A complex authentication and authorization system with user management, JWT tokens, role-based access control, and session management

userStories.title: Project Setup and Database
userStories.description: Initialize project with database layer for user persistence
acceptanceCriteria: Database schema: users (id, email, password_hash, role, created_at, updated_at)
Database schema: sessions (id, user_id, token, expires_at, created_at)

userStories.title: User Model and Validation
userStories.description: Define user data models with comprehensive validation
acceptanceCriteria: User interface: id, email, passwordHash, role (admin|user), createdAt, updatedAt
Session interface: id, userId, token, expiresAt, createdAt
Zod schemas for: RegisterInput, LoginInput, UpdateProfileInput
Password requirements (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, number)

userStories.title: Password Hashing
userStories.description: Implement secure password hashing and verification

userStories.title: JWT Token Generation
userStories.description: Implement JWT token creation and verification
acceptanceCriteria: Include userId, email, role in payload
Tests for token generation and verification

userStories.title: User Registration
acceptanceCriteria: Checks if email already exists (409 if duplicate)
Creates user with role: 'user' by default
Returns 201 with user data (no password) and JWT token

userStories.title: User Login
userStories.description: POST /api/auth/login - Authenticate user and return token
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 200 with user data and JWT token

userStories.title: Authentication Middleware
userStories.description: Create middleware to protect routes with JWT verification
acceptanceCriteria: requireAuth() middleware extracts Bearer token from Authorization header
Returns 401 if token missing, invalid, or expired
Tests with valid and invalid tokens

userStories.title: Role-Based Access Control
userStories.description: Implement authorization middleware for role checking
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 403 if user lacks required role
Tests for admin-only and user access
userStories.notes: Authorization layer on top of authentication

userStories.title: Update User Profile
acceptanceCriteria: Checks email uniqueness if changing email

userStories.title: Admin User Management
userStories.description: Admin endpoints to list and manage users
acceptanceCriteria: All endpoints protected with requireAuth and requireRole('admin')
Tests for admin access and forbidden scenarios

userStories.title: Session Cleanup
userStories.description: Implement automatic cleanup of expired sessions
acceptanceCriteria: cleanupExpiredSessions() function deletes expired session records
Called periodically (e.g., every hour) using setInterval
Tests verify expired sessions are removed
